title: UK ETS maritime eligible-fuel emissions-reduction claim QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS
UK Emissions Trading Scheme for maritime: how to comply

facts.source_fact: Domestic maritime emissions enter the UK ETS from 1 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the correct first-scheme-year start date.

facts.source_fact: The first maritime scheme year runs from 1 July to 31 December 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not annualise the first period without explicit methodology.

facts.source_fact: Maritime monitoring covers carbon dioxide, nitrous oxide and methane within scheme scope.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve gas identity before CO2e aggregation.

facts.source_fact: Maritime emissions are expressed in carbon dioxide equivalent.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the CO2e conversion basis.

facts.source_fact: A maritime operator must apply for an emissions monitoring plan within the applicable statutory timeframe after becoming in scope.
facts.expected_handling: Require approved-plan provenance before monitoring claims.

facts.source_fact: Verified annual emissions reports are due by 31 March in the year following the scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Track report due date and verification status.

facts.source_fact: The surrender obligation is based on the emissions figure for surrender.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute gross monitored emissions for the surrender figure.

facts.source_fact: The emissions figure for surrender is maritime emissions minus any applicable surrender deduction.
facts.expected_handling: Store the deduction separately and retain its basis.

facts.source_fact: A successful emissions-reduction claim can create a surrender deduction for eligible fuel use.
facts.expected_handling: Require successful-claim evidence before applying a deduction.

facts.source_fact: Eligible fuels can be assigned an emission factor of zero following a successful emissions-reduction claim.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply a zero factor automatically to a fuel label.

facts.source_fact: Ministerial directions define which maritime fuels are eligible for the emissions-reduction claim.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the applicable direction and regulator jurisdiction.

facts.source_fact: Fuel eligibility includes requirements for certification under a recognised voluntary scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Require certification provenance for claimed fuel.

facts.source_fact: Eligible-fuel directions include sustainability criteria.
facts.expected_handling: Keep sustainability evidence with the claim.

facts.source_fact: Eligible-fuel directions include greenhouse-gas emissions-saving criteria.
facts.expected_handling: Keep saving-criteria evidence with the claim.

facts.source_fact: Any applicable surrender deduction is included in the annual emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Reconcile claim evidence to the verified annual report.

facts.source_fact: One UK allowance must be surrendered for each tonne of CO2e in the emissions figure for surrender.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the one-to-one allowance rule only to the final surrender figure.

facts.source_fact: Allowances for the 2026 and 2027 maritime scheme years are due by 30 April 2028.
facts.expected_handling: Use the combined transitional surrender deadline.

facts.source_fact: From the 2028 scheme year, surrender is due by 30 April in the following year.
facts.expected_handling: Version surrender deadlines by scheme year.

facts.source_fact: Maritime surrender is made from the maritime operator holding account in the UK ETS Registry.
facts.expected_handling: Bind surrender evidence to the correct registry account.

facts.source_fact: The eligible-fuel claim is a maritime operator compliance mechanism, not a parcel-level emissions measurement.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent geographic parcel inference from compliance claims.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve claim and surrender rules exactly.
Attach operator, vessel activity, gas and scheme-year scope.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents out-of-scope voyage or fuel claims.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach scheme year and applicable ministerial direction.
Carry certification, sustainability, GHG-saving and verifier provenance.
Do not convert maritime claims into parcel-level measured emissions.
